scope: Development-only merge5-to-published-master region registration; not a letter benchmark
prior_exposure: Both complete images, prior numeric results and Segal edition context already viewed. Visual hypothesis: merge5 belongs to the right initial blank margin. Not blind or held out from project development.

algorithm.read: IMREAD_GRAYSCALE; source PNGs immutable; analysis arrays only, no image output
algorithm.resize: INTER_AREA image; INTER_NEAREST mask; exact original/analysis scale recorded
algorithm.matching: L2 BF 2-nearest; forward ratio<0.75 and mutual best; unique descriptor pair
algorithm.partition: Sort by original texture y,x and master y,x; every third pair (index modulo3 equals2) is validation, all other pairs fitting
algorithm.fit: estimateAffine2D RANSAC on fitting pairs only, original pixel coordinates

provisional_region_gate.limits: Coarse development-region localization only. Correlated features, not independent reading controls. An affine may fail on a locally warped composite. Retain all residuals and failure; no parameter search to force pass. No pixel-exact or letter-scale gate.

evaluation: Report all fit/validation pair residuals, all prior19 measured target projections, image bounds and feature coverage. Compare coordinate result with edition fig2/initial-margin description; do not infer a letter from intensity or declare all blank pixels authenticated. If gate fails, retain unresolved registration.
